scheme_name: Refund of Subscriptions for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal
Benefit is payable upon reaching age 60, or after 3 years of registration if the subscriber chooses not to continue, or to the nominee in case of death
benefits_summary: Refund of the deposited subscription with 8% interest.
